_comment: Session 9E — which play-test robot belongs to which game.
One source of truth, read by scripts/editor-qa-run.mjs (the runner the GitHub
Action calls) and by api/manifest.js (so a save can tell the owner honestly
whether a robot exists for the game he just edited).
Key = the manifest id / editor CATALOG id. Value = the qa-*.mjs at the repo root.
A game with no entry here is NEVER reported as passing — it is reported as
'no robot yet', which is the honest answer.
